caption: The drawing shows a single vertical object centered on a plain, beige background, resembling an ornately decorated gold or brass rod or column with a flared top section and a stepped lower end. The shaft of the object displays intricate linear and swirling patterns in brown and gold tones with some greenish tints. To the left of the rod and slightly above its midpoint, there is a small, circular object encircled by a gold border and filled with a cross-hatch or lattice pattern, colored in blue and gray tones; a line extends from this circle diagonally to the top left, and a handwritten word ("climpot" or similar) is present just above the circle. The overall composition is minimal, with only these two drawn elements on an otherwise empty surface.
title: Refillable Pencil
